ValidationRule.description: Ensures that a Lead in "Nurtured" status can only return to "In Progress" or be moved to "Closed Lost".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Nurtured"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Lost")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid status change. From "Nurtured", the Lead can only go back to "In Progress" or be moved to "Closed Lost".
